# Reject binary attachments during ingestion

## Context and Problem Statement

Some feeds attach audio and video enclosures. Storing them would multiply our
storage footprint by two orders of magnitude.

## Decision Outcome

Rejected. Dropping enclosures outright would break podcast feeds, which are a
first-class use case. Enclosures are kept as URLs and never downloaded.

## Consequences

Storage stays small because we keep references rather than bytes. Playback
depends on the publisher keeping the enclosure reachable.
